notes.title: Your feedback has been incredible
notes.content: [p]Thank you to everyone who has played and is still playing the demo! Your feedback has been incredible.[/p][p][/p][p]We are currently focused on fixing the bugs and optimizing the demo.[/p][p][/p][p]This is just the beginning, we are also preparing a major update for the demo that will introduce new gameplay mechanics and content beyond the prologue you’ve experienced.[/p][p][/p][p]If you encounter any bugs or issues, please let us know on our [url="https://discord.gg/YhK9q5JkWw"]Discord.[/url][/p]

notes.title: Demo Available!
notes.content: [p][b]We’re thrilled to announce that the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3834600/House_of_Empty_Names/"]Demo[/url] for our game is now live![/b][/p]
